_comment: Every person and organisation named on the site, and where their name should link. One entry per entity, looked up by the exact name used in the other data files. A null url renders as plain text — never as a dead or wrong link. URLs are stored in their clean public form: no /posts/, no ?feedView, and never an /admin/ URL (those only work for page admins and 404 for everyone else).

NexLead.note: Numeric page id — supplied as an /admin/dashboard/ link, normalised to the public company URL. Replace with a vanity slug once NexLead claims one.
